review_scope: delivered pixels only; no identity or same-person inference
reference_use_observation: Across all three renders, the supplied portrait was used only for observable adult-appearance cues: an adult-presenting subject with long dark wavy hair and natural facial proportions. This is not an identity, likeness, or same-person judgment.

vo_composition_center_anchor_location.evidence: The true frame center at approximately (511.5, 768.5) lands on the plain upper apron and torso, while the identity-bearing face and action-bearing hands and rolled map sit above and below it.

vo_composition_center_anchor_dominance.evidence: At thumbnail scale, the illuminated face and centrally placed adult figure are the first visual read.

vo_composition_center_supporting_margins.evidence: The dark doorway jambs, top beam, receding shelves, and flooded corridor channel attention inward.

vo_composition_center_not_symmetry_only.evidence: The figure establishes central dominance while the shelves, lamp, plaque, and doorway remain visibly asymmetric.

vo_composition_frame_scene_bound_opening.evidence: A thick archive doorway with a fixed catalog plaque is visibly part of the photographed scene.

vo_composition_frame_three_side_enclosur.evidence: The top beam and both side jambs enclose the subject on three readable sides.

vo_composition_frame_near_plane_depth.evidence: Jamb thickness, edge highlights, mounted plaque, and occlusion prove a nearer foreground plane.

vo_composition_frame_not_vignette.evidence: Resolved material, hardware, and thickness make the opening physical rather than a vignette or graphic border.

vo_composition_hierarchy_primary_first.evidence: The large central adult figure and illuminated face own the strongest first-read signal.

vo_composition_hierarchy_secondary_subor.evidence: The brass catalog plaque remains readable but is clearly subordinate to the figure.

vo_composition_hierarchy_background_supp.evidence: Cool receding shelves and water reflections separate the subject without taking first attention.

vo_composition_hierarchy_not_blur_only.evidence: Scale, central placement, warm-cool contrast, and semantic importance establish hierarchy beyond blur.

vo_composition_third_anchor_location.evidence: The runner's face and raised-flag cluster lies near the upper-left thirds intersection.

vo_composition_third_anchor_off_center.evidence: The runner cluster is unmistakably displaced to the left of the exact frame center.

vo_composition_third_surrounding_field.evidence: The wet pier, railing, lamps, and ferry retain enough surrounding field to explain the placement.

vo_composition_third_not_overlay_or_crop.evidence: Visible subject and pier geometry establish the thirds relation without a grid overlay or incidental crop.

vo_composition_room_direction_vector.evidence: Profile orientation, stride, bent arms, raised flag, and hair streaming left establish rightward travel.

vo_composition_room_origin_visible.evidence: The runner and the pier region behind her remain visibly inside the frame.

vo_composition_room_greater_ahead.evidence: The open pier and ferry field ahead occupies roughly two thirds of the frame, substantially more than the space behind.

vo_composition_room_not_wrong_side.evidence: Railing, lamp rhythm, boards, and ferry extend directly along the rightward travel vector.

vo_composition_pattern_baseline_readable.evidence: Four blue capped pier lamps establish a clearly repeated form and state baseline.

vo_composition_pattern_single_exception.evidence: One same-family foreground pier lamp glows amber while the four receding lamps glow blue.

vo_composition_pattern_exception_focal.evidence: At the stored thumbnail scale, the large amber lamp is the strongest isolated luminance and color accent while the blue row remains legible.

vo_composition_pattern_not_random_variet.evidence: The row preserves one lamp family with one color-state exception; the ferry beacon is not a member of that row.

vo_composition_asym_primary_mass.evidence: The large dark-coated adult figure is the strongest mass and is clearly left of center.

vo_composition_asym_secondary_counterwei.evidence: The small saturated red beacon at center-right visibly counterweights the larger dark figure.

vo_composition_asym_intervening_space.evidence: A broad pale fog interval and bridge span separate the unequal visual weights.

vo_composition_asym_not_clutter_or_symme.evidence: Scale and color contrast, rather than symmetry or clutter, produce the balance.

vo_composition_room_direction_vector.evidence: The visible body reads as stationary or paused, the legs and stride are cropped, and the eyes turn toward the camera; the bridge line alone is not the subject's motion vector.

vo_composition_room_origin_visible.evidence: The adult figure and near bridge entry remain visibly inside the lower-left frame.

vo_composition_room_greater_ahead.evidence: Large space exists to the right, but without a legible gaze or motion vector it cannot be verified as space ahead.

vo_composition_room_not_wrong_side.evidence: The fog field follows the bridge, but no visible subject vector links her to that direction; her clearest eye-line is cameraward.

vo_composition_negative_large_field.evidence: Pale fog forms one contiguous low-detail field across most of the upper and right frame.

vo_composition_negative_subject_separati.evidence: Dark hair and coat form a clean readable contour against the simpler fog field.

vo_composition_negative_hierarchy.evidence: The simplified fog makes the dark adult figure immediately legible as the primary subject.

vo_composition_negative_not_crop_or_expo.evidence: Fog gradients, softened dish and antenna silhouettes, and damp bridge texture preserve intentional material information.
